title: Ji Meng AI Integrates with Seedance 2.5 and Launches Maya/Blender Plugins, ByteDance Completes the Full Workflow of AI Video Professional Creation
excerpt: ByteDance's content creation platform, Jiemow AI, has officially integrated the Seedance 2.5 model and launched multiple professional creation tools for complex
content_html:
ByteDance's content creation platform, Jiemow AI, has officially integrated the Seedance 2.5 model and launched multiple professional creation tools for complex projects, including Maya and Blender plugins and an intelligent editing mode. This marks Jiemow AI's accelerated expansion from a creative tool for general users to a professional film and 3D production workflow.

Seedance 2.5 is a video generation model released by ByteDance on July 31st. It was previously launched on Jiemow AI and Doubao Professional Edition. This model doubles the single-video generation length from 15 seconds to 30 seconds, enabling multi-shot narrative structures such as setup, development, turning point, and conclusion within a single video. It also supports multi-round extension while maintaining consistency in character subject, scene, visual style, and audio.

Maya and Blender Plugins Integrate 3D Workflow

The newly launched Maya and Blender plugins mean that Jiemow AI's AI video generation capabilities can now be directly embedded into the workflow of mainstream 3D creation software for the first time. Creators no longer need to switch back and forth between the Jiemow platform and professional 3D tools. Instead, they can call the generation and editing capabilities of Seedance 2.5 directly within Maya or Blender, seamlessly integrating AI-generated content with professional 3D scenes.

This integration holds significant meaning for professional fields such as film special effects, animation production, and industrial design. Traditionally, AI-generated video materials needed format conversion and manual alignment before being integrated into 3D pipelines. Native plugins significantly reduce this friction.

Intelligent Editing Mode Lowers the Barrier for Complex Projects

The synchronized launch of the intelligent editing mode targets a broader range of complex project scenarios. Creators can make local modifications, replace scenes, adjust character appearances, and change visual styles without re-generating the entire video, greatly reducing the time cost of creative iteration.

From generating 30-second narrative videos to maintaining consistency across multiple rounds of extension, and now integrating into the professional pipelines of Maya and Blender and launching the intelligent editing mode, Jiemow AI is gradually breaking through the complete "from concept to delivery" workflow. When AI video tools are no longer limited to toy-level clip generation but are truly embedded into the daily production toolchains of professional creators, the toolkit for short video and even film production may be undergoing a substantial transformation.

content_html_zh:
字节跳动的内容创作平台Jiemow AI已正式集成Seedance 2.5模型，并推出了多种针对复杂项目的专业创作工具，包括Maya和Blender插件以及智能编辑模式。 这标志着杰莫AI从普通用户的创意工具加速拓展到专业的电影和3D制作流程。

Seedance 2.5是字节跳动于7月31日发布的视频生成模型。 此前已在界魔AI和豆宝专业版上线。 该模型将单视频生成长度从 15 秒增加一倍至 30 秒，从而在单个视​​频中实现多镜头叙事结构，例如设置、发展、转折点和结论。 它还支持多轮扩展，同时保持角色主题、场景、视觉风格和音频的一致性。

Maya 和 Blender 插件集成 3D 工作流程

新推出的Maya和Blender插件意味着杰模AI的AI视频生成能力现在可以直接嵌入到主流3D创作软件的工作流程中。 创作者不再需要在杰莫平台和专业3D工具之间来回切换。 相反，他们可以直接在 Maya 或 Blender 中调用 Seedance 2.5 的生成和编辑功能，将 AI 生成的内容与专业 3D 场景无缝集成。

这种融合对于电影特效、动画制作、工业设计等专业领域具有重要意义。 传统上，AI生成的视频素材在集成到3D管道之前需要进行格式转换和手动对齐。 本机插件显着减少了这种摩擦。

智能编辑模式，降低复杂项目门槛

智能编辑模式的同步上线，针对更广泛的复杂项目场景。 创作者可以进行本地修改、替换场景、调整角色外观、改变视觉风格，而无需重新生成整个视频，大大降低了创意迭代的时间成本。

从生成30秒的叙事视频，到多轮扩展保持一致性，再到如今融入Maya和Blender的专业流程并推出智能剪辑模式，杰莫AI正在逐步突破“从概念到交付”的完整工作流程。 当AI视频工具不再局限于玩具级的剪辑生成，而是真正嵌入到专业创作者的日常制作工具链中时，短视频甚至电影制作的工具包可能正在发生实质性的转变。
